reviews.author: Kiyana Chhabra
reviews.body: Pendant dekhne mein expensive jewellery jaisa lagta hai. Gold tone shine bahut natural aur classy hai.

reviews.author: Zavian Ahuja
reviews.body: Elephant ki detailing bahut hi neatly ki gayi hai. Har choti detail pendant ko premium appearance deti hai.

reviews.author: Meher Narula
reviews.body: Jewellery collection mein yeh mera favourite pendant ban gaya hai. Elephant design bahut adorable aur meaningful lagta hai.

reviews.author: Reyansh Dhamija
reviews.body: Is pendant ki quality dekhkar laga ki purchase bilkul paisa vasool thi. Finishing bahut clean hai aur chain bhi strong lagti hai. 😊
